headline_cluster.headline: דו"ח: זינוק באבחוני פוסט־טראומה מאז 7.10 - והמספרים ממשיכים לעלות
headline_cluster.body_note: haaretz.co.il blocked by egress proxy (and article is .premium/paywalled); body content not read and not guessed. Search-engine index lists this same URL under the title 'כללית: זינוק של 121% בפניית ילדים ובני נוער למיון פסיכיאטרי מאז 7 באוקטובר - הארץ', i.e. the article is Haaretz's write-up of the Clalit three-year report (homepage teaser headline differs from the indexed article title).

primary_source.name: Clalit Health Services report on the health effects of three years of war (published ~Oct 1-4, 2026)
primary_source.publisher: Clalit Health Services (comments by Prof. Amir Krivoy, director, Geha Mental Health Center; CEO Prof. Eitan Wertheim)
primary_source.population: ~5 million Clalit members; sub-analyses for general population, southern (Gaza-envelope) evacuees, northern evacuees, children/adolescents
primary_source.time_window: Oct 2023 - Sep 2026 (war years 1-3), compared with pre-war baseline (year / two years before the war)
primary_source.access_note: Clalit primary document/press release not directly fetched: clalit.co.il not surfaced and all Israeli news domains (haaretz, ynet, maariv, israelhayom, i24news, jdn, walla) are blocked by the egress proxy. Figures below are taken from consistent search-index extracts of multiple independent outlets (ynet/ynetnews, Maariv, Israel Hayom, i24NEWS, JDN, Walla) reporting the same Clalit release.

key_figures.general_population_new_PTSD_diagnoses: +100% (doubled) in war year 1 vs pre-war; trend 'did not subside' in years 2-3 (elevated plateau; no year-over-year increase reported)
key_figures.southern_evacuees_new_PTSD_diagnoses: x18 in year 1, x11 in year 2, x6 in year 3 vs pre-war year (declining multiplier, still elevated)
key_figures.high_stress_populations_summary: new PTSD diagnoses remain 2-6x pre-war levels in year 3 (Krivoy)
key_figures.children_teens_psychiatric_ER_visits: +78.3% in year 2, +121.3% in year 3 (this metric is the one rising year over year)

primary_source.other_context: Separate earlier Maccabi data (Haaretz, Jul 2025): adult PTSD diagnoses ~3,400/yr avg 2016-2022, 6,245 in 2023, 8,234 in 2024 - rising through 2024; not the source of this Oct 2026 report.

clustering_note: Single-outlet (haaretz) item explicitly citing a 'דו"ח' (report) on PTSD diagnosis trends since Oct 7, general population (not limited to children, unlike the psychiatric-ER-visits cluster). Possibly related to Ministry of Health mental-health data but kept as a separate story since the claimed population and metric (diagnoses, not ER referrals) differ. AUDIT UPDATE: the underlying report is the same Clalit three-year report that drives the children's psychiatric-ER-visits cluster, and the Haaretz URL is indexed under a 121%-ER-visits title - consider merging the two stories.

claims.claim_text: דו"ח: זינוק באבחוני פוסט־טראומה מאז 7.10 (headline, part 1)
claims.source_figure: Clalit: new PTSD diagnoses in general population doubled (+100%) in war year 1 vs pre-war; among southern evacuees x18 in year 1.
claims.note: A doubling (and x18 among evacuees) is fairly described as a surge. Based on secondary reporting of the Clalit release; primary document not directly read.

claims.claim_text: והמספרים ממשיכים לעלות (headline, part 2: the numbers keep rising)
claims.source_figure: Clalit: general-population new PTSD diagnoses jumped in year 1 and 'did not subside' in years 2-3 (plateau at elevated level); southern evacuees x18 -> x11 -> x6 (falling). The only metric reported as rising year over year is children/teen psychiatric ER visits (+78.3% yr2 -> +121.3% yr3), not PTSD diagnoses.
claims.note: The report shows a persistent elevation, not a continuing increase, in new PTSD diagnoses; for evacuees the excess is shrinking. 'Keep rising' only holds trivially for cumulative totals or by conflating with the ER-visits metric. Body text unread, so it is unknown whether the article body qualifies this.

audit_note: Article body unreadable (haaretz.co.il egress-blocked + premium paywall) - only the homepage headline was audited. Primary source identified as Clalit's Oct 2026 three-years-of-war report (~5M members), but its figures were verified only via consistent multi-outlet search-index extracts, since Clalit and all Israeli news sites were unreachable from this environment. Headline 'surge' is accurate; 'numbers keep rising' is overstated: new PTSD diagnoses plateaued (general population) or declined relative to baseline (evacuees x18->x11->x6). Likely duplicate of the children psychiatric-ER-visits cluster (same report, same Haaretz URL indexed under the 121% title). Re-run with body access to complete.
